what: A one-line caption (name·service·place·year·view link) is pinned at the center of the section (screen 50vh) where tilted large work photos scroll down, when a photo item is over 40% on screen, the caption text and link switch to that item’s immediately (no transition). The caption is white text + difference, so over a photo it reads as the photo’s opposite color and over the background as the text color

options.ratio: Switch when this much of the item is visible (0~1), default .4
options.look: plain: Turn off difference and keep the text color as is
options.--fx-top: Height where the caption attaches (style), default 50vh
options.--fx-pad: Side margins of the caption (style), default 10px
options.[data-fx-part=caption]: Sticky caption line — the [data-key inside=title|tags|loc|year] cells are filled from the same data-* of the item (title keeps bold text tags as they are)
options.[data-fx-part=link]: (Optional) link inside the caption — becomes the item’s data-href or the first link address
